finalCanvases.explanation:
The central tree retains the five conceptual components while reducing the seed from 116 to 77 lines (33.6%) and from 8,478 to 5,581 characters (34.2%). Five peripherals expand validation, retry semantics, record ownership, evidence transport, and diagram identity. M = modular structure, C = call flow, O = ownership, D = data dependency; these perspectives coexist within each tree. Edges attach to the relevant central concept, and positions leave measured gaps between text rectangles.

Grounding: conversation behavior comes from domain/core/agents/agentContext.ts; library and retry behavior from application/mapping/agent/agentContextLibrary.ts and domain/core/agents/savedAgentContext.ts; publication and locking from infrastructure/core/persistence/fileAgentContextRepository.ts; capture and transport from infrastructure/core/persistence/fileAgentContextSources.ts; diagram identity from domain/core/diagrams/diagramAgentContext.ts. Only the supplied point, sources, and seed were used as evidence.

Corrections and qualifications: trajectory cycle/missing-link checks cover the traversed ancestor slice, not the entire trajectory. The seed's stale-comment-hash failure claim needs an exception: an identical existing comment receipt returns before checking the current snapshot hash. Diagram loading validates backing identity but does not compare the saved fingerprint or revision against current evidence; the point's change-detection claim therefore requires caller behavior absent from these inputs. The background message requests the current diagram on later edits, but these files do not establish that callers supply it. Source-file checks use the 16 MiB constant despite stale 2 MiB error text and comments. Portable conversion recomputes the hash but need not change its value.

New peripheral details include missing-attachment acceptance during snapshot validation, repeated expansion byte accounting, noncanonical request hashing, cache eviction order, source-ID fallback, and full-record reads behind summaries. Implementations of imported source-range helpers, ImmutableRecords, and session-launch callers are not supplied; their internals and end-to-end session behavior remain unverified.
